description.narrative: The Rural Development Agency (RDA) is a private social enterprise registered with the Office of Industry and Trade, Lao PDR. The RDA was established in 2009 under the umbrella of the Participatory Development Training Center (PADETC). In 2015 it changed its name to the Rural Development Agency or RDA. RDA's mission is to empower rural communities by facilitating holistic, self-sustaining capacity development in areas such as environmental education, WASH, nutrition, and youth and women’s empowerment. RDAcurrently has a team of 22 employees with 2 managers, 5 team leaders, 13 officers and 7 learning staff. Each team member possesses specific knowledge and skills that allow them to effectively implement RDA projects. RDA has an extensive network that includes key government ministries, including the Ministry of Natural Resource and Environment (MoNRE), the Ministry of Agriculture and Forest (MAF), and the Ministry of Health; local authorities such as the Provincial Office of Natural Resources and Environment (PONRE), Provincial Health Department, and the Provincial Office of Health. faculties from the National University of Laos, including the faculties of forestry science, environmental studies and social sciences, as well as key international organizations such as GIZ, Save the Children, Oxfam, Care International, and IUCN. RDA is also a founding member of the “Environmental Education for Change in Laos (EEC Laos) Alliance and an active member of the Laos CSO Network.

participating-org.narrative:
RDA is a Lao-based non-profit social enterprise founded in 2009 as an offshoot of PADETC (Participatory Development Training Centre). RDA began as a semi-autonomous organization SuanMaiLao Eco-Forest Learning Centre (SML) which focused on educating youngpeople and the general public on the importance of ecology in relation to holistic education and development. SML would go on to become the Rural Development Agency (RDA) in 2015. RDA has gone on to expand its efforts toward developing and participatingin projects that take community centred approaches in WASH, Nutrition, Environmental Conservation and Youth Engagement.
RDA Vision is to become a model Agency that inspires and empowers rural communities. Our mission is facilitating a holistic self-sustaining capacity strengtheningand quality provision of services in community education, environmental health and youth empowerment. The overall objective / Goal is to be recognized as innovative industry leaders, delivering quality programs in communitydevelopment by investing in the trainingof RDAs human resources, fostering, creativity and developing individual capacity.
RDA has extensive experience and networks within the Lao PDR working with young people, communities, local authorities and villagefunctionalities in promoting sustainable and inclusive community development in Lao PDR. RDA believes communities have the ability to be self-sustaining when their capacity, confidence, networking, and dialogue skills are developed.
